events.description: CIA information report on Usama Bin Ladin's funding of the Egyptian Gama'at al-Islamiya and on the composition of its Sudanese wing.
The CIA issued an information report on Bin Ladin's funding of the Gama'at al-Islamiya and the composition of its Sudanese wing. The report is described as not finally evaluated intelligence.

relationships.detail: Bin Ladin is described as a regular supporter of the Egyptian Gama'at al-Islamiya; the report title refers to his funding.
Described as a wealthy Khartoum-based Saudi oppositionist (the OCR is garbled).
The report title refers to a Sudanese wing of the Egyptian Gama'at al-Islamiya, so the group had a presence in Sudan.

sources_cited: CIA information report (not finally evaluated intelligence), 22 July 1993
key_claims: Usama Bin Ladin, a wealthy Saudi oppositionist in Khartoum, was a regular financial supporter of the Egyptian Gama'at al-Islamiya in 1993.
The Gama'at al-Islamiya had a Sudanese wing, whose composition the report describes.
